title: A General Theory of Risk Sharing
abstract: arXiv:2505.19276v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a new paradigm for risk sharing that generalizes earlier models based on discrete agents and extends them to allow for sharing risk within a continuum of agents. Agents are represented by points of a measure space and have potentially heterogeneous risk preferences modeled by risk measures on a separable probability space. We derive the dual representation of the value function using a Strassen-type theorem for the weak-star topology and provide a characterization of the acceptance set using Aumann integration. These results are illustrated by explicit formulas when risk preferences are within the family of entropic and expected shortfall risk measures, and applications to Pareto efficiency in large markets.

translated_abstract: 我们引入了一种新的风险分担范式，它推广了早期基于离散主体的模型，并将其扩展至允许在连续统的主体之间分担风险。主体由测度空间中的点表示，其可能异质的风险偏好通过可分概率空间上的风险度量来建模。我们利用弱星拓扑下的Strassen型定理推导了值函数的对偶表示，并借助Aumann积分给出了接受集的刻画。当风险偏好属于熵风险度量和期望损失风险度量族时，这些结果通过显式公式得到说明，并应用于大市场中的帕累托效率问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个将风险分担理论从离散主体推广到连续统主体的一般性新范式，利用Strassen型定理和Aumann积分刻画了值函数的对偶表示与接受集，并给出了熵与期望损失风险度量下的显式公式及其在大市场帕累托效率中的应用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a general theory of risk sharing extending discrete-agent models to a continuum of agents, deriving dual representations of the value function via a Strassen-type theorem and characterizing acceptance sets through Aumann integration, with explicit formulas for entropic and expected shortfall risk measures and applications to Pareto efficiency in large markets.
